slogan.description: A quote the app shows at the top of the page, with who said it if anyone did.

about.title: Details
about.question: What's this {noun, select, stay {stay} other {place}} called, and what's it like?
about.description: A name, and the full story.
about.tipBody: Lead with what makes it worth the trip. The app shows the first lines on the page; the rest opens under Read more.

foodAbout.tipTitle: Lead with what people come for
foodAbout.tipBody: “Charcoal-grilled river fish, open late” tells a traveller more than “good food and friendly service”. The app shows the first lines on the page; the rest opens under Read more.

location.title: Location
location.question: Where is it?
location.description: Paste the {noun, select, stay {stay} other {place}}'s Google Maps link, or find it on the map. Its province and address are filled in from the pin, for you to check.
location.tipTitle: Putting the pin on the place
location.tipBody: Copy the {noun, select, stay {stay} other {place}}'s link in Google Maps (Share, then Copy link) and paste it here, or search it by name. Then switch to Satellite and drag the pin onto the entrance. At the place with a phone? Use the crosshair on the map. A pair of coordinates typed into the box works too.

found.stays: Travellers see this stay on the page of every destination within 50 km of its pin — a hotel in Siem Reap on Angkor Wat's page, say.
found.foods: Travellers see this place on the page of every destination within 50 km of its pin — a noodle shop in Siem Reap on Angkor Wat's page, say.
found.activities: Travellers see this activity on the page of every destination within 50 km of its pin, and under its type on the Interests tab.

contact.title: Contact
contact.question: Who runs it, and how do travellers get in touch?
contact.description: Who looks after this listing, and the ways to reach it.
contact.tipBody: A number that is answered beats three that are not. Put the one travellers should use, and the chat app it is on.
contact.detailsDescription: Shown on the listing so travellers can ask before they go.
contact.messagingDescription: Most travellers in Cambodia ask on Telegram or WhatsApp first; the {noun, select, stay {stay} other {place}}'s page opens a chat.

photos.title: Photos
photos.question: Show it at its best
photos.description: Every photo travellers can page through. The cover is the first thing they see of this {noun, select, stay {stay} other {place}} — on cards, in search, and across the top of its page: choose it among them.
photos.tipBody: A bright landscape photo of the place itself, with no text, logos or collages. 1600 × 900 pixels or larger stays sharp everywhere.

review.title: Review
review.question: Ready to go live?
review.description: Check what is still missing. Publishing and saving are the buttons at the top.
review.tipBody: A published listing appears on the website straight away. A draft stays in the dashboard until it is published, and either can be changed later.

classification.title: Where it appears
classification.question: What kind of place is it?
classification.description: Its tourism region with that region's own categories and tags, then the interests travellers find it under.
classification.tipBody: Choose the region the place is best known for. Only that region's categories and tags are offered, and the place is listed on its Discover page. Interests are separate: tick what a traveller comes for, whatever the region.
classification.interestsDescription: The Interests tab and province pages it is listed under.

activityType.title: Type of activity
activityType.question: What kind of activity is it?
activityType.description: The kind travellers browse by on the Interests tab. Tick every one that fits.
activityType.tipBody: A boat trip to watch dolphins is a Cruise and Wildlife both: tick both. The first one ticked names the kind the app files it under.

facilities.title: Rooms & facilities
facilities.question: What is the property, and what does it offer?
facilities.description: The type of property, its facilities and policies, and each kind of room once.
facilities.tipBody: A guest who chooses a stay for its pool expects to find one. Leave out anything seasonal or on request. Add each kind of room once; copy a room to make the next one like it, and mark one unavailable instead of deleting it.
facilities.policiesDescription: Check-in and check-out, children, pets, smoking, how guests pay — written out, the way the app shows them.

menu.title: Food & drink
menu.question: What does it serve, and what does it cost?
menu.description: The type of place, its price range, how people pay, and when it is open.
menu.tipBody: The type and the price range are what the app filters by, and the opening hours save a wasted trip. Today's dishes live on the place's Facebook page, which has its own box under Contact.

more.title: More details
more.question: Anything else?
more.description: The last few details this listing can hold.
more.tipBody: Fill in what you know; everything here can be added later.

reviewStep.title: Review & send
reviewStep.question: Ready to send for review?
reviewStep.description: Check what is still missing, then send it to {reviewer}. It goes on the website once they approve it.
reviewStep.tipBody: {reviewer} approves it, asks for changes, or rejects it with a reason — you see the answer on your Requests page. You can keep editing it while it waits.
